title: 第76章 这是一个正常修士能干出来的事第75章 一天一百遍啊一百遍
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
第76章这是一个正常修士能干出来的事？
灵识淬炼不断进行中。
陆成的灵识不断分裂愈合。
陆成的五官极度扭曲，但他的口中没有因剧痛而蹦出一个字。
他面色痛苦，但那坚毅的眼神却是直接看呆了青璇。
时间足足过去了一刻钟左右。
陆成仿佛感觉自己的灵识被人拿着一把长满獠牙的锯子，不断将他的灵识锯开，又快速愈合。
直到一刻钟以后，陆成的身躯不再剧烈颤抖，他那原本痛苦的脸颊上此刻竟露出一丝笑容。
陆成眼中更是盈满着笑意。
“不，不可能！！”青璇呢喃道，她美目一直停留在陆成身上，不放过陆成一丝神情，直到此刻看到陆成脸上的笑容后，她以自己才能听到的声音，骇然道：“竟…竟然真的筑基成功了！”
陆成的灵识在最后一次愈合后，便再也没有受到锤炼。
紧跟着，一股舒爽的感觉席卷全身。
首当其冲的是，陆成感到自己此刻精神焕发！
就在刚刚，他感觉到自己的寿命，直接增加了百余年！
原本的一百年寿命，随着踏入筑基境，直接变成了二百年。
陆成睁开双目，看向双手和自身，脸上露出狂喜。
放在蓝星，普通人的寿命大多是七八十岁，高寿者则能达到九十到一百来岁。
若是遇到疾病，可能五六十岁，乃至更年轻，可能就会撒手人寰！
而在这个修仙的世界，他内视自身，感受到自己身体的变化。
他的心脏跳动充满了活力，他的皮肤更加光滑细腻，乃至他的头发，都变得极其黝黑，极有光泽。

他的寿命，却是在此刻发生了极大的改变。
若是不遭遇意外，平平安安一生，陆成绝对认为自己能活到二百岁。
并且随着境界提高，他的寿命还会更长！
陆成内视丹田，他丹田内的灵气此刻早已液化，化作几滴灵液在丹田中。
若是随着灵液的增长，将这丹田彻底充盈后，陆成便能凝聚金丹，成为金丹境修士，他的寿命更会增长！
而在他的意识操控下，那几滴灵液变得更加凝练，操控也更随心！
紧跟着，陆成感到自己“精神念力”大幅提升，宫殿内的一切物品都清晰可见！
他甚至能听到上方青玄看向他时眼神中充满的震惊，以及她颇有规律的呼吸声。
只可惜这座宫殿，他不知是什么材质打造而成，竟将他的灵识彻底隔绝，他只能感受到这座宫殿内的一切，但是宫殿外，却完全探查不到！
几秒钟过后，他浑身一震。
陆成脸上再度露出喜色，这时他突然发现，他丹田内的那几滴灵液流出丹田，进入了他的经脉！
灵液进入经脉后，开始不断通过经脉，向他的四周开始流去。
骤然间，一股舒爽的感觉再次席卷全身。
一股酥麻的感觉让陆成脸上露出陶醉的表情。
紧跟着，陆成便闻到了一股恶臭，从他的浑身毛发排出。
这是踏入筑基境后，灵力洗髓伐骨，排出大量杂质与瘀血。
紧跟着，他又感受到一股剧痛！
这是“筋断骨”般的重塑之痛！
content_en:
Chapter 76 Is this something a normal monk can do?
The tempering of spiritual consciousness is in progress.
Lu Cheng's spiritual consciousness continued to divide and heal.
Lu Cheng's facial features were extremely distorted, but not a single word came out of his mouth due to the severe pain.
His expression was painful, but his determined eyes stared directly at Qingxuan.
About a quarter of an hour passed.
Lu Cheng felt as if his spiritual consciousness was being held by someone with a saw full of fangs, constantly sawing his spiritual consciousness open, and then quickly healing it.
It was not until a quarter of an hour later that Lu Cheng's body stopped shaking violently, and a smile appeared on his originally painful cheek.
Lu Cheng's eyes were filled with smiles.
"No, it's impossible!!" Qingxuan murmured. Her beautiful eyes stayed on Lu Cheng, not letting go of Lu Cheng's expression. Until she saw the smile on Lu Cheng's face, she said in shock in a voice that she could only hear: "Unexpectedly... the foundation building was actually successful!"
After Lu Cheng's spiritual consciousness was healed for the last time, it was never tempered again.
Immediately afterwards, a feeling of relief swept through my body.
The first thing that hit him was that Lu Cheng felt that he was full of energy at the moment!
Just now, he felt that his life span had increased by more than a hundred years!
The original life span of one hundred years directly became two hundred years as he entered the foundation building realm.
Lu Cheng opened his eyes and looked at his hands and himself, with ecstasy on his face.
On Blue Star, most ordinary people's lifespan is seventy or eighty years old, while those with long lifespans can reach ninety to one hundred years old.
If you encounter a disease, you may be in your fifties, sixties, or even younger, and you may die!
In this world of immortality, he looked inside himself and felt the changes in his body.
His heart beat full of vitality, his skin became smoother and more delicate, and even his hair became extremely dark and shiny.
His life span has changed greatly at this moment.
If he didn't encounter any accidents and lived a peaceful life, Lu Cheng definitely believed that he could live to be 200 years old.
And as his realm improves, his lifespan will be longer!
Lu Cheng looked inside his dantian. The spiritual energy in his dantian had already liquefied and turned into a few drops of spiritual liquid in his dantian.
If the dantian is completely filled with the increase of spiritual liquid, Lu Cheng can condense the golden elixir and become a golden elixir realm monk, and his lifespan will be even longer!
And under the control of his consciousness, those few drops of spiritual liquid became more condensed, and the control became easier!
Immediately afterwards, Lu Cheng felt that his "mental power" had greatly improved, and all the items in the palace were clearly visible!
He could even hear the shock in Qingxuan's eyes when she looked at him, as well as her regular breathing.
It's a pity that this palace, he didn't know what material it was made of, completely isolated his spiritual consciousness. He could only feel everything inside the palace, but he couldn't detect anything outside the palace!
After a few seconds, he was shocked.
Lu Cheng's face showed joy again, and then he suddenly discovered that the few drops of spiritual liquid in his Dantian flowed out of his Dantian and entered his meridians!
After the spiritual fluid entered the meridians, it began to flow continuously through the meridians and began to flow around him.
Suddenly, a feeling of relief swept through my body again.
A numb feeling made Lu Cheng's face look intoxicated.
Immediately afterwards, Lu Cheng smelled a foul odor coming from the hair all over his body.
This is after entering the foundation-building realm, the spiritual power cleanses the marrow and cuts the bones, expelling a large amount of impurities and blood stasis.
Immediately afterwards, he felt another sharp pain!
This is the pain of reshaping like "broken muscles and bones"!
